title: Resampling Amplifies Injection: Interpretability-Blind Control Protocols Strengthen Adversarial Attacks

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests whether AI control mechanisms can be weaponized by adversaries, turning a safety mechanism into an attack amplifier. High-stakes finding for defer-to-resample protocols.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Implementing a defer-to-resample loop, training an SAE-based monitor, and crafting adversarial soft prompt injections targeting the monitor's feature space is a multi-system engineering task. Each component has significant complexity for beginners.
